Art-Net is an open published standard. This driver speaks the controller half (sends ArtDmx) and works with any conforming node — ETC Response Mk2, Pathway Path-Port, Enttec ODE / DIN, Elation E-Node, ADJ Net4, Chauvet Net-X, Madrix-driven LED controllers, Color Kinetics PDS gateways, GrandMA Net Processing units, Resolume / TouchDesigner / Madrix as Art-Net inputs, etc.
HomeWorks QS Processor (HQP6-2 and HQP7). Other Lutron systems (RadioRA 3, Caseta SB Pro, Athena, QS Standalone) speak related but distinct protocol surfaces and are not covered by this driver.

Both bridge generations expose the V1 REST API on port 80. The V2 bridge (square, BSB002) is the current production model and also supports the V2 / CLIP V2 API over HTTPS — this driver targets V1 only. The V1 bridge (round, BSB001) is end-of-life for new firmware but still functional.
